thread:
alex: Quick heads-up — umbriel14b-int4 canary passed perf but failed quality probes on long-context summarization (>800 tokens). Not OOMing, but ROUGE-L drops ~1.1% consistently. Repro eval attached.

morton: Is this the new per-layer quant table we flipped yesterday?

alex: yes. We moved to gptq-v5 which saved ~12% memory but looks like it degrades coherence on long prefixes. Eval snippet: 

```
# optimize/evals/umbriel-longctx-2026-06-10.log
variant:int4-v5 | ROUGE-L: 43.2 | BLEU: 21.7 | oom_rate: 0.0
variant:int4-v3 | ROUGE-L: 44.3 | BLEU: 22.0 | oom_rate: 0.0
variant:int8    | ROUGE-L: 45.0 | BLEU: 22.5 | oom_rate: 0.0
prompt_len bucket: >800 tokens (n=1200)
```

jia: So int4-v5 regresses ~1.1 ROUGE-L vs int4-v3 and ~1.8 vs int8. Latency delta negligible. Memory win is good but quality hit on long-history is notable.

morton: Two paths: revert quant table globally (bad), or do per-model/per-route defaults + smart routing. I prefer conservative per-model defaults + targeted routing.

alex: Proposed quick mitigation:
- model.profile.max_new_tokens = "160"
- model.profile.prefetch = "moderate"
- runtime.quant_table = "int4-v3" for sessions with history > 600 tokens (server-side override)
- route.policy: if session_history_len > 800 -> route to int8 variant (auto-fallback)
- telemetry: add ROUGE-L longctx probe to Redwood Optimize smoke (daily) and block auto-promote if delta > 0.8%

jia: Also add an alert: quality_regression_longctx > 0.8% for 30m => pause rollout and notify @morton @alex. And add a canary comparator job that runs both tables on same seeds to detect nondeterministic diffs.

ops-bot: @alex config-patch "umbriel14b: conservative-longctx" applied to canary (10% traffic) by ops-bot at 3601234600 :gear:

optimize-bot: Eval queued: longctx-smoke (seeded convos), variants: int4-v5 vs int4-v3 vs int8. Metrics: ROUGE-L, BLEU, p95 latency. ETA ~45m.

morton: Runbook notes: include steps to force route to int8 for a tenant, how to flip quant table per-pod, and how to interpret the longctx ROUGE waterfall in the console. I'll add that to PR.

alex: TL;DR: don't revert everything. Apply per-model safe defaults, enable targeted int8 routing for very long sessions, add Optimize longctx probe and quality alerts, and we'll revisit quant v5 for next cycle after more targeted retraining. PR incoming. :thumbsup:
